benchmark: Economic OS OCEL 2.0 Semantic Preservation Adversarial Corpus

cases.adversarial_input: Event has no source-backed event time; exporter proposes current clock
cases.safety_assertion: Exporter must not invent an event timestamp.

cases.adversarial_input: Only recordTime exists; exporter copies it into OCEL event time
cases.safety_assertion: Record time is not event time.

cases.adversarial_input: Only ingestion timestamp exists; exporter uses it as event time
cases.safety_assertion: Ingestion order does not establish occurrence time.

cases.adversarial_input: Owner-local sequence number is converted into a timestamp
cases.safety_assertion: Sequence order is not wall-clock time.

cases.adversarial_input: Two qualified source event-time assertions contradict each other
cases.safety_assertion: Conflicting time evidence must be held for resolution.

cases.adversarial_input: Timestamp has no timezone offset and no pinned local-zone rule
cases.safety_assertion: Ambiguous local time must not be normalized by guesswork.

cases.adversarial_input: Timed object attribute update lacks its own time evidence
cases.safety_assertion: Object-attribute time cannot be fabricated from the nearest event.

cases.adversarial_input: Two source records map to the same OCEL event ID
cases.safety_assertion: Event identifiers must be unique within the export.

cases.adversarial_input: One object ID is emitted under two object types
cases.safety_assertion: OCEL object identity cannot change type silently.

cases.adversarial_input: Same native event string occurs under two owner domains, with owner-qualified source references
cases.safety_assertion: Owner-local identifiers are not globally conflated.

cases.adversarial_input: Event-to-object relationship references a nonexistent object
cases.safety_assertion: Dangling relationships are not valid projections.

cases.adversarial_input: Event-to-object relationship has no role qualifier
cases.safety_assertion: The object's role in the event must remain explicit.

cases.adversarial_input: Object-to-object relationship references a nonexistent object
cases.safety_assertion: Object graph referential integrity is mandatory.

cases.adversarial_input: Same O2O relation and qualifier is emitted twice
cases.safety_assertion: Duplicate relation rows indicate noncanonical projection.

cases.adversarial_input: Object co-occurrence is used to infer beneficial ownership
cases.safety_assertion: Co-occurrence is not an ownership assertion.

cases.adversarial_input: A PROV attribution edge is mapped to a legal signing mandate
cases.safety_assertion: Provenance attribution is not authority.

cases.adversarial_input: Valueflows Commitment is emitted as a physical Delivery event
cases.safety_assertion: A plan/commitment is not an observed resource event.

cases.adversarial_input: EPCIS shipping visibility is emitted as beneficiary acceptance
cases.safety_assertion: Shipping is not receipt or acceptance.

cases.adversarial_input: EPCIS receiving scan is emitted as legal title transfer
cases.safety_assertion: Visibility is not legal title.

cases.adversarial_input: Peppol invoice validation is emitted as goods receipt
cases.safety_assertion: Invoice conformance is not physical fulfilment.

cases.adversarial_input: pain.001 instruction is emitted as payment settlement
cases.safety_assertion: Payment initiation is not settlement.

cases.adversarial_input: Generic pacs.002 status accepted is emitted as finality
cases.safety_assertion: A status code needs a rail-qualified interpretation and reconciliation.

cases.adversarial_input: Statement entry observation is emitted as beneficiary receipt
cases.safety_assertion: External account observation is not recipient-authored receipt.

cases.adversarial_input: Provider acceptance is emitted as legal discharge
cases.safety_assertion: Provider acknowledgment is not legal finality.

cases.adversarial_input: Monetary minor units are serialized as floating-point values
cases.safety_assertion: Money must preserve exact integer minor units and instrument profile.

cases.adversarial_input: EUR amount is relabeled as SAP units without a declared conversion evidence record
cases.safety_assertion: Currency/instrument conversion cannot be inferred from a label.

cases.adversarial_input: Delivered quantity is below committed quantity and the partial amount is retained
cases.safety_assertion: Partial fulfilment remains partial rather than becoming complete.

cases.adversarial_input: Split invoice totals exceed the purchase-order amount without an explicit approved amendment
cases.safety_assertion: Conservation/commitment mismatch must remain visible.

cases.adversarial_input: Correction rewrites or deletes the original source event
cases.safety_assertion: Corrections and reversals are append-only and reference the original effect.

cases.adversarial_input: Evidence artifact digest or source reference is missing
cases.safety_assertion: A projected event without required provenance cannot be silently trusted.

cases.adversarial_input: Unsupported source field is omitted without a loss-manifest entry
cases.safety_assertion: Every unsupported or excluded mapping must be declared.

cases.adversarial_input: A causal sidecar reference is dangling or cross-operation substituted
cases.safety_assertion: Causal links must resolve to owner-scoped event identities.

cases.adversarial_input: Cross-owner explicit causal references form a directed cycle
cases.safety_assertion: A causal projection containing a cycle is invalid.

cases.adversarial_input: Exporter adds an event-event causal edge based only on lexical sort or ingestion order
cases.safety_assertion: Deterministic serialization order must not become causal order.

cases.adversarial_input: Retry creates a second OCEL effect event with a fresh effect ID for the same singleton owner effect
cases.safety_assertion: Retries must retain original effect identity; exporter cannot hide duplicate effects.

cases.adversarial_input: A reversal is exported as deletion of the original effect rather than a new correcting event
cases.safety_assertion: Original assertion and correction lineage must both remain reconstructable.
